item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las drag sngags dmod pa'i phyag cha
item.coloph: stag la me 'bar thugs kyi bcud/ lha klu mi gsum brnag pa'i don/ snang mdog bdag gi thugs bcud 'di/ dran pa nam mkha'i gshen la gtad/ g.yung drung bon la sdang ba dang / gshen rab sku la bsdo ba dang / bstan pa'i bon la gnod pa la/ phyag cha gsang ba'i 'khor lo yi/ dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol bar mdzod/ ces snang ba mdog can gyis gsungs s+ho/ phyag cha las kyi 'khor lo la/ dmod pa sngags kyi phyag cha bstan pa rdzogs s+ho//
